video_title: “I Could Never Play for My Father” - Jalen Brunson Explains Why He LOVES It

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the unique dynamic of Rick Brunson coaching Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: He's been in your ear, he's been probably a pain in the ass all your life when it comes to basketball.
quotes.quote: Your dad, my guy, Coach Rick Brunson. He's been in your ear, he's been probably a pain in the ass all your life when it comes to basketball, right? That balance of him being on the coaching staff and you actually having your space. Because the rest of the world don't know this, but during the season, we're around the people in the locker room them more than we're around our own families. And so, I'm just trying to see like, now as a grown man, now as a franchise player, like the balance. We've seen times where Rick had to, you know, he checked your ass on that sideline. And you gave a little pushback and then all of a sudden you had to catch yourself like, yeah, let me fall back for a minute.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on how Bobby Hurley influenced his relationship with his father
quotes.excerpt: Knowing your dad's being a coach is when he's being a dad.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: I'll say this. Going back to when I was in middle school, I think we were at a basketball tournament watching a family friend or whatever. And me and Dad see, don't know if it's coincidence or not, but thankfully I saw him. I saw Bobby Hurley, as a dad. Bobby Hurley's a dad. And Bobby Hurley said, knowing your dad's being a coach is when he's being a dad. And that sentence has literally stuck with me ever since. So from that point on, whenever Dad like coached me on the court, it was never personal. It was strictly basketball. Yes, sometimes I get pissed and sometimes it would drag on to just everyday stuff, but I knew what he was saying was strictly basketball related.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Remember you didn't get me that toy in 1993? Look at you now, motherfucker. Fuck you, coach. What's this, doing basketball? It made me upset. Fuck you, coach.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the boundaries he sets with his father during games
quotes.excerpt: If we get in spats like we did in Atlanta, that's not father-son, that's player-coach.
quotes.quote: I remember the first time I said, I heard you, I think I said shut the hell up. And like, there's no difference. There's a 100% difference. And so, but our relationship's great. When it comes to games, where he thinks I don't play well or thinks I didn't do anything, things I didn't do the right thing or whatever, he won't call me after games. He won't send me anything, he won't call me after games. We wait until next day to talk about it. He would not call me after games unless like I, maybe once in my career since I've been in New York he's called me after a game. But he refuses to call me after games, winner or loss or whatever, because he knows he's the coach.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on how his daughter changed his father's demeanor
quotes.excerpt: Thankfully having my daughter now, I've seen a different side of my father.
quotes.quote: I think we have a great balance. And I think honestly, thankfully having my daughter now, I've seen a different side of my father. And so he's for the better. For the better. A little softer now, you know. He's always, he doesn't come over to see me anymore. He comes over to go straight to the baby. So like, it's definitely a balance. But he's our relationship, I think is the best because people don't understand it. Everyone says, I could never play for my father. I was like, well, that's you. I like having someone who holds me accountable every single day, whether I'm happy, pissed, or whatever. He's pushing me to be better every single day.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his father's track record of being right
quotes.excerpt: My dad has always, he's been 99% right on everything that happens in my career.
quotes.quote: My dad has always, he's been 99% right on everything that happens in my career. Which is so annoying. It's so annoying. It's so annoying. He's like, in high school, he's like, you continue to work, you continue to do this every single day, you find ways to get better every single day. You find ways to get better every single day. Going to Villanova, he's like, hey, you just got to find a way to be a star in your role. You want a national championship my freshman year. Then he told me how to do this and this and this. You win national player of the year, you win another one. It happened. Every single stage he's always been right. I'm just like, I can't not listen to him. He's been right.
